notes: Partition verified: s001–s020 and t001–t023 each appear once.
'the cause' is `added` because mah and hāyāh each already hold a rendering of their own ('What', 'is'), so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet and the surplus answers to no morpheme.
The 'wisely' fusion carries the whole of mē-ḥoḵmāh and heads on the morpheme carrying the lexeme (rule 30); the marginal Hebrew gloss corroborates without deciding (rule 38).

'the former days' writes one 'the' for two articles: the noun's own takes it and the agreement article is `unrepresented` (rules 22, 47). The fronted 'dost' is the verb's own, no interrogative particle standing in the clause (rule 17).
